name: kiro-spec
description: Kiro-compatible Spec workflow (requirements to design to tasks) for three hosts: DeepSeek Harness, Codex, and Claude.

scripts.pack:dsh-spec: rm -f dist/dsh-spec.plugin && node scripts/pack-plugin.mjs dsh-spec --out dist/dsh-spec.plugin
scripts.pack:codex-spec: rm -f dist/codex-spec.plugin && node scripts/pack-plugin.mjs codex-spec --out dist/codex-spec.plugin
scripts.pack:claude-spec: rm -f dist/claude-spec.plugin && node scripts/pack-plugin.mjs claude-spec --out dist/claude-spec.plugin
scripts.pack:all: pnpm run pack:dsh-spec && pnpm run pack:codex-spec && pnpm run pack:claude-spec
